logical_ownership.scope: conservative fixture raw/HMAC/tuple-int/metadata and two snapshot envelope; excludes interpreter, application receipts, source/model/runtime and allocator/RSS

real_geometry.ceiling_scope: unpruned u32 geometry only, NOT optimized serving traffic or a saving estimate
real_geometry.geometry_source: decode-cache-sdk-reference.md: 24 layers, 2 KV heads, dimension 64, vocabulary 151936

synthetic_topology.restart: synthetic index rebind; public artifact cache persists; no real process spawned

thresholds.branch: h > (capture+validation+lookup+fallback extra bytes)/(shared rows*64 + avoided sessions*128); all quantities same scope
thresholds.delta: network ceiling=0 locally; hit disk saving=(parent_rows*8) in fixture; metadata unchanged
thresholds.first_unique_request: zero unless declared sibling batch already repeats exact causal prefix; cold setup always charged
thresholds.receipt: retry_probability > publication_cost/(avoided_retry_cost - lookup_cost), if denominator positive; compare optimized full-hit decode, not replay

unknown: actual runtime controls/framing including inference->preparation acknowledgements
